source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Rear Suspension and Drive Line, p.4-34

procedures.title: Pinion flange, dust deflector and/or oil seal: replace
steps: (continued) Set the seal in the bore and put gauge plate J-22804-1 over it against the seal flange.
Press the seal in with J-21057 until the gauge plate is flush with the carrier shoulder and seal flange (see figure 86 in the manual).
Turn the gauge plate 180 degrees from its installed position to check that the seal is square in the bore.
Oil the flange splines and tap the flange on.
Fit the washer and nut and tighten until the nut lines up with the mark on the pinion.
Raise the propeller shaft and connect it to the companion flange and transmission yoke.
Put the rubber cushion on the carrier front mount, set the bracket in place and loosely fit the rear carrier-to-bracket bolt.
Fit the front mounting nut and front carrier-to-bracket bolt; torque everything to specification and fit the cotter pin in the carrier bracket front bolt.
notes: The gauge plate makes sure the seal seats correctly; the seal must be square to seal against the flange.

procedures.title: Differential carrier: remove and install
steps: Removal: disconnect the spring end link bolts (see Spring Removal).
Disconnect the drive shafts at the carrier by removing the U-bolts holding the trunnions to the side gear yokes.
Disconnect the carrier front support bracket at the frame crossmember.
Disconnect the propeller shaft at the transmission and companion flange; slide the transmission yoke forward into the transmission and drop the shaft down and out to the rear.
